title: English Learning Progress Tracker
content:
Purpose

English: Track your progress in vocabulary, grammar, reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills.
Hindi: Apni shabdawali, vyaakaran, paath, lekhan, bol chal, aur sunne ki kshamata ko anukramit tarike se maapen.

title: Set Learning Goals
content:
Steps

English: Identify weekly or monthly goals such as learning new words, completing exercises, or writing paragraphs.
Hindi: Saptahik ya mashik lakshya tayaar karen, jaise naye shabd seekhna, abhyas karna, ya nibandh likhna.

title: Daily Practice Log
content:
Use

English: Maintain a daily log of exercises done, new words learned, and speaking practice.
Hindi: Rozana kiye gaye abhyas, seekhe gaye shabd, aur bolne ki abhyas ki suci banayen.

title: Self-Assessment
content:
After Each Session

English: Rate your confidence in each skill area (grammar, vocabulary, etc.) from 1 to 5.
Hindi: Har abhyas ke baad apne vishwas ko 1 se 5 ke beech ank dein, jaise vyaakaran, shabdawali, aadi.

title: Weekly Review
content:
Summary and Adjustments

English: At the end of the week, review your log and identify strengths and areas for improvement.
Hindi: Saptah ke antim mein apni suchi dekhen aur majbooti evam sudhar ke kshetra nirdharit karen.

title: Sample Progress Table
content:

title: Tips for Effective Tracking
content:
• Be consistent and honest in recording.
  • Use colors to highlight progress or difficulty.
  • Set realistic, achievable goals.
  • Reflect regularly to motivate yourself.
